method.selection: thresholds chosen on the validation split (2-decimal grid 0.01-0.99), costs reported on the test split
method.threat_score: highest confidence among all boxes in the image, any class, no IoU matching (0 if none)
method.miss_cost: a threat bag's miss cost is that of its most severe ground-truth class (gun > knife > scissors > pliers / wrench)
method.threat_weighting: each threat bag weighs threat_mix[class] / (threat bags of that class in the split); all means over threat bags use these weights
method.clean_score: stand-in: highest confidence among boxes with IoU <= 0.1 with every ground-truth box
method.model_alone: searched if score >= t, else pass
method.design: pass if score < t_low, review if t_low <= score < t_high, search if score >= t_high
method.chosen_policy: design with the cost-optimal (t_low, t_high) pair on validation
method.alternative_0_7: design with t_high = 0.7 and the cost-optimal t_low for it on validation (earlier proposal)
method.screener: catches a checked threat with probability reviewer_catch; never sends a clean bag to search (reviewer_sends_clean = 0)
method.ties: lowest t_low, then lowest t_high, among equal costs
method.counts: plain bag counts in the split (not weighted)

sensitivity.case: screener sends 10% of checked clean bags to search
threat mix as labelled in the splits
